# @three-ws/create-agent

> One command from a sentence to a rigged, animated 3D agent you can embed anywhere. npm create @three-ws/agent "a friendly cartoon astronaut"

@three-ws/create-agent is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/create-agent`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/create-agent/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/create-agent/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/create-agent/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/create-agent/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
